Class ImplDeckBD

java.lang.Object
com.dami.tcg.modelo.ImplDeckBD
All Implemented Interfaces:
DeckDAO
public class ImplDeckBD extends Object implements DeckDAO
JDBC-based implementation of the DeckDAO interface.

Provides concrete database operations for Deck entities using direct JDBC connections. Handles deck persistence including the many-to-many relationship between decks and cards via the DecksCards junction table. Database connection parameters are loaded from the configDB.properties resource bundle.

Author:
Brayan, Adam, Oihan and Asier

    • insertDeck

      public boolean insertDeck(Deck deck)
      Inserts a new deck into the database, including its card associations.

      Inserts the deck into the Decks table and then batch-inserts all card associations into the DecksCards junction table. The deck is only inserted if it does not already exist. Generated keys are used to retrieve the new deck ID.

      Specified by:
      insertDeck in interface DeckDAO
      Parameters:
      deck - the Deck to insert
      Returns:
      true if the insertion was successful, false otherwise

    • deleteDeck

      public boolean deleteDeck(Deck deck)
      Deletes a deck and its card associations from the database.

      First removes all card associations from the DecksCards junction table, then deletes the deck itself from the Decks table. The deck must exist in the database.

      Specified by:
      deleteDeck in interface DeckDAO
      Parameters:
      deck - the Deck to delete
      Returns:
      true if the deletion was successful, false otherwise
